hero.name: Sahu Rishikesh
hero.title: CS Student | AI-Augmented Developer | Web Developer
hero.tagline: I build real-world applications by combining full-stack development, AI, and automation to turn ideas into working products.

bio: I'm a Second-Year Computer Science student at BNN College, Bhiwandi, with a strong interest in web development, AI, and automation. My interest in coding grew through experimenting with different AI tools and discovering how much they can accelerate the development process.

I enjoy building practical projects that solve real-world problems rather than just creating projects for the sake of learning. From full-stack web applications like FYCS Study Hub to AI-powered automation projects like Jarvis, I'm constantly experimenting with new ideas and technologies.
My long-term goal is to build impactful AI-powered products, explore the capabilities of emerging technologies, and eventually work with different companies on challenging real-world projects.
about.funFact: I regularly put different AI models against each other to compare their actual capabilities and find out which AI performs best for different types of tasks.

skills.aiAugmentedWorkflow: I use AI-assisted development to turn ideas into functional applications by describing what I want to build, iterating with AI-generated code, testing the results, debugging issues, and continuously refining the product.
